hero.name: Nguyen Manh Tu
hero.summary: Backend Engineer with 2+ years building REST APIs, batch jobs and asynchronous services using Java, Spring Boot, PostgreSQL, AWS SQS and Docker. Recently focused on AI application engineering: semantic search, RAG systems, CV/JD matching and AI interview platforms with FastAPI, Qdrant, OpenAI and LiveKit.

fpt.summary: Developed and maintained backend APIs for recruitment & HR systems using Java, Spring Boot and PostgreSQL — a 20% increase in system efficiency.
bullets: Implemented batch jobs and asynchronous processing flows using AWS SQS and backend scheduling.
Used Docker and LocalStack to support local development and testing of cloud-integrated services.
Reviewed code, supported teammates and led a 4–5 member backend sub-team as sub team lead.
Coordinated task assignments, tracked progress and ran technical reviews — a 30% boost in team productivity during the lead's absence.
Built REST APIs ensuring seamless service integration and data flow.

projects.title: Featured Projects
projects.subtitle: Products I've built — from AI platforms to enterprise backend systems.

vcareer.title: VCareer
vcareer.subtitle: AI Career Development Platform
vcareer.description: End-to-end AI career platform: real-time AI interviews (WebRTC · LiveKit · OpenAI Realtime · Gemini Live), a 3D TalkingHead avatar, CV improvement, CV/JD matching and application tracking. Built on a Next.js full-stack architecture with Server Components, Server Actions, Zod and Drizzle ORM over Neon PostgreSQL. 1st Runner-up at Codex Hackathon 2026.

scholarai.title: ScholarAI
scholarai.subtitle: AI-Augmented Research Workspace
scholarai.description: AI-powered engine to discover and read academic papers: hybrid semantic search (dense + BM25 via Qdrant RRF), citation-aware chat-with-paper (streaming RAG over SSE), an in-app PDF reader with highlights/notes, and project-based writing. RAG quality measured with LangSmith (retrieval hit rate, citation accuracy, faithfulness).

finplanning.title: Financial Planning System
finplanning.subtitle: Expense management & tracking system
finplanning.description: Expense management system helping enterprises make financial data and internal processes transparent. Java Spring Boot backend with RESTful APIs for expense management and reporting, a React + Tailwind frontend, and Redis for caching and query performance.
